newsitem.title: USA: Shoney's Inc sets record date for meeting.
newsitem.headline: Shoney's Inc sets record date for meeting.

text.p: Shoney's Inc said on Monday that it has set July 14 as the record date for shareholders to participate in the company's special meeting.
Shoney's had received a request for such a record date from Raymond Schoenbaum, who is heading a group called Shoney's Shareholders' Committee, on June 25.
A meeting date has not yet been set, a company representative said.
New York Stock Exchange rules require that the Exchange receive at least ten days advance notice of record dates from listed companies, the company said in a statement.
Schoenbaum is attempting to replace the company's board.
The company said it will be soliciting proxies against Schoenbaum's nominees and Salomon Brothers will act as the company's financial advisor in this proxy solicitation.
